recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for this issue unless ITS later changes RDF extension syntax again.
issue_request: FHIR-39078 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core ITS change request asking that the Extensibility page reflect the syntax change made to the R5 FHIR RDF format for extensions; its resolution says PR #2570 clarifies the R5 RDF (Turtle) syntax for extensions.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify commit 7ca696486bfafc3a012b1235cdfd10aff258fae3, the merge of PR #2570. That merge included implementation commit e1276243c6d167a3eb38b1effd6410565ec0039b, which added RDF-specific extension value[x] guidance and examples to source/extensibility.html and reorganized source/rdf.html to include non-modifier, primitive, and modifier extension guidance.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini and source/hierarchy.xml show the Extensibility and RDF pages are active build-scope narrative pages. Later source edits touched the same pages, but current source still preserves the FHIR-39078 RDF extension guidance. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later discussion, and a related Jira text search returned only FHIR-39078.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/extensibility.html states that RDF uses fhir:value for value[x] with an explicit type assertion, includes a Turtle extension example, links primitive-extension handling to the RDF page, and points modifier-extension readers to the RDF example. Current source/rdf.html contains the corresponding extension sections.
